description: This file defines the 'Reviewer' entity class for the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It manages reviewer data such as status, comment, associated ratings, group, review, and employee, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: Reviewer
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer in the OrangeHRM performance review system, with fields for status, comments, associated ratings, group, review, and employee, leveraging Doctrine ORM for database persistence.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reviewer.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the reviewer.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the reviewer.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: setCompletedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment associated with the review.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for the review.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the reviewer group associated with this review.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Associates a reviewer group with this review.

methods.name: setReview
methods.description: Associates a performance review with the reviewer.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this reviewer.
